title: Verify interrupted recipe recovery in a live session
changes: Document a real interrupted recipe client and bounded status-wait recovery in an isolated EUR interpreter session.
validation: Windows GNU runtime build passed. The owned client was terminated during its wait after one completed frame; an external frame satisfied the wait, explicit resume completed the next step with the same original request identity, and a second resume left guest state unchanged. Frame offsets were 0, 1, 2, 3, 3; the session closed normally and protected inputs were unchanged.

Two initial test-bridge launches exited before GUI because they inherited FFTA_VALIDATION variables forbidden by the isolated-session guard; their diagnostics remain. A Sol/xhigh read-only source consultation identified the bridge environment mismatch; the D-Bus warning also appeared in an earlier passing run.
limitations: This proves interruption of the client during a status wait in one EUR Wine/Xvfb interpreter session, not a crash during a pending mutating request, session restart, native Windows or physical input. The successful unit keeps private session inputs as a named current-proof exception pending replacement.
